<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>The Monglish Immersive Learning Model</title>
<meta name="description" content="Teacher training deck: the Monglish immersive learning model, from theory to the club ecosystem.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..144,300;0,9..144,400;0,9..144,600;1,9..144,400&family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* Tokens lifted from the Monglish Learning Hub so the deck and the Hub are
   one surface: same void, same orange, same Fraunces and Manrope. */
:root{
  --navy:#135e80;
  --navy-lift:#1f7ba3;
  --navy-deep:#0a3b54;
  --orange:#f17c21;
  --gold:#f0a94b;

  --void:#04131f;
  --void-2:#071f31;
  --void-3:#0b3049;

  --ink:#eaf3f8;
  --ink-soft:#b7cbd7;
  --ink-mute:#8CA8BA;
  --line:rgba(160,200,225,.16);
  --line-strong:rgba(160,200,225,.32);

  --display:'Fraunces','Spectral',Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;
  --body:'Manrope','Segoe UI',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;

  --r-sm:10px; --r-md:16px; --r-lg:24px;
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);
  --glow:0 0 0 1px rgba(241,124,33,.5), 0 0 26px -2px rgba(241,124,33,.45), 0 0 62px -8px rgba(241,124,33,.35);
}

*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{height:100%}
body{
  margin:0;background:#020811;color:var(--ink);
  font-family:var(--body);font-size:18px;line-height:1.6;
  overflow:hidden;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- stage */
#viewport{position:fixed;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;padding-bottom:60px}
#stage{
  position:relative;width:1600px;height:900px;transform-origin:center center;
  overflow:hidden;border-radius:2px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 50% at 50% 34%, #0a2a45 0%, #061326 46%, transparent 78%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#061326 0%,#020811 64%,#020811 100%);
  box-shadow:0 30px 90px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.9);
}
#sky{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;display:block;pointer-events:none}

.slide{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;padding:56px 76px 104px;display:none}
.slide.is-active{display:block}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ typography */
.eyebrow{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1em;
  font-size:15px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:#cbdae3;margin:0 0 16px;
}
.eyebrow::before{content:'';width:34px;height:2px;background:var(--orange);flex:none}

h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:300;letter-spacing:-.015em;margin:0}
h1{font-size:74px;line-height:1.06;color:#f4fafd;text-wrap:balance}
h2{font-size:52px;line-height:1.08;color:#f4fafd;margin-bottom:12px;text-wrap:balance}
/* The brand gradient from the Hub hero, on the word that carries the slide. */
h1 em,h2 em{
  font-style:normal;
  background:linear-gradient(96deg,#f17c21 6%,#e59a5c 34%,#9ac7e4 68%,#bcdcf1 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;
}
h3{font-family:var(--body);font-weight:700;font-size:22px;line-height:1.25;color:#f4fafd;
  letter-spacing:0;margin:0 0 8px}
h4{font-family:var(--body);font-weight:700;font-size:19px;line-height:1.3;color:#f4fafd;margin:0 0 6px}

p{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:18px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.55;color:var(--ink-soft);text-wrap:pretty}
.sub{font-family:var(--display);font-style:italic;font-weight:400;font-size:26px;
  color:var(--orange);margin:0 0 14px;letter-spacing:.005em}
.lede{font-size:20px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.5;color:#c6d9e4;max-width:74ch}
.small{font-size:17px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.5}
em.accent{font-style:normal;color:var(--gold);font-weight:800}
strong{color:#f4fafd;font-weight:800}

.head{max-width:80ch;margin-bottom:30px}
.head p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}

.slide-foot{
  position:absolute;left:76px;right:76px;bottom:30px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;
  border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:13px;
  font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink-mute);
}
.slide-foot .pg{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:#cbdae3;letter-spacing:.06em}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- pieces */
.card{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(11,48,73,.62), rgba(7,31,49,.5));
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:24px 26px;
  box-shadow:0 20px 44px -28px rgba(0,0,0,.9);
}
.card--tint{background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(19,94,128,.34), rgba(10,59,84,.26));
  border-color:var(--line-strong)}
.card--accent{
  background:linear-gradient(140deg, rgba(241,124,33,.2), rgba(10,59,84,.5));
  border-color:rgba(241,124,33,.42);
  box-shadow:0 22px 50px -26px rgba(241,124,33,.5);
}

.fact{background:rgba(19,94,128,.26);border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:var(--r-sm);
  padding:13px 16px;font-size:18px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.45;color:#c6d9e4}
.fact b{color:var(--gold);font-weight:800}

.chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;border-radius:999px;padding:5px 14px;
  font-size:15px;font-weight:700;background:rgba(160,200,225,.12);color:#d8e7f0;
  border:1px solid var(--line-strong);white-space:nowrap}
.chip--onsite{background:rgba(241,124,33,.18);border-color:rgba(241,124,33,.45);color:#F7B77A}
.chip--online{background:rgba(31,123,163,.24);border-color:rgba(120,186,224,.45);color:#A7D3EC}

.ar{display:block;font-size:17px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink-mute);
  direction:rtl;text-align:left;unicode-bidi:isolate}

.grid{display:grid;gap:20px}
.g2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
.g3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
.g4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
.g5{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr)}

.mongiz{position:absolute;bottom:0;pointer-events:none;user-select:none}
.mongiz img{display:block;height:100%;width:auto;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 18px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.6)) drop-shadow(0 0 40px rgba(241,124,33,.18))}

.note{position:absolute;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:15px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(11,48,73,.8), rgba(7,31,49,.72));
  border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:var(--r-md);
  padding:17px 22px;box-shadow:0 24px 50px -26px rgba(0,0,0,.95);max-width:430px}
.note img{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 10%;
  background:rgba(19,94,128,.4);border:1px solid var(--line-strong);flex:none}
.note .who{font-size:14px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--orange);margin:0 0 5px}
.note p{font-size:18px;line-height:1.45;margin:0;color:#c6d9e4}

/* --------------------------------------------------- interactive diagrams */
/* Every node in a diagram is a real button: click or press Enter to light it
   and read the detail below. The glow is the affordance, not decoration. */
.node{
  appearance:none;font:inherit;text-align:inherit;cursor:pointer;color:inherit;
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-md);
  background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(11,48,73,.62), rgba(7,31,49,.5));
  transition:box-shadow .35s var(--ease), border-color .35s var(--ease),
             transform .35s var(--ease), background .35s var(--ease);
}
.node:hover{border-color:rgba(241,124,33,.45);
  box-shadow:0 0 22px -4px rgba(241,124,33,.38);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.node:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--orange);outline-offset:3px}
.node.is-lit{
  border-color:rgba(241,124,33,.75);
  background:linear-gradient(150deg, rgba(241,124,33,.22), rgba(11,48,73,.72));
  box-shadow:var(--glow);transform:translateY(-2px);
}
.node.is-lit .node-k{color:var(--gold)}

.detail{
  position:absolute;left:76px;right:76px;bottom:90px;min-height:84px;
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:18px 24px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(11,48,73,.42), rgba(7,31,49,.34));
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;
  transition:border-color .35s var(--ease), box-shadow .35s var(--ease);
}
.detail.is-lit{border-color:rgba(241,124,33,.4);box-shadow:0 0 34px -12px rgba(241,124,33,.45)}
.detail .dot{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--orange);flex:none;
  box-shadow:0 0 16px 2px rgba(241,124,33,.7);opacity:0;transition:opacity .35s var(--ease)}
.detail.is-lit .dot{opacity:1}
.detail .txt{font-size:18px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.5;color:#c6d9e4;margin:0}
.detail .txt b{color:var(--gold);font-weight:800}
.detail.is-idle .txt{color:var(--ink-mute)}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- slide 1 */
.title-slide{padding:0;display:none}
.title-slide.is-active{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 600px;align-items:center}
.title-copy{padding:0 0 0 76px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}
.brandmark{height:56px;width:auto;align-self:flex-start;margin-bottom:38px}
.title-slide h1{margin-bottom:14px}
.title-art{position:relative;height:100%}
.title-art .mongiz{left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);height:800px}
.title-art::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:-140px;translate:-50% 0;
  width:620px;height:340px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(241,124,33,.34), transparent 72%);
  filter:blur(6px)}
.byline{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-top:30px;padding:13px 26px;
  border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);background:rgba(160,200,225,.08);
  font-size:17px;font-weight:700;color:#d8e7f0}
.byline i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--orange);
  box-shadow:0 0 12px 2px rgba(241,124,33,.8)}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- slide 2 */
.orbit{position:relative;height:376px}
.orbit-line{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1}
.orbit-grid{position:relative;z-index:2;height:100%;display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 292px 1fr;grid-template-rows:1fr 1fr;
  column-gap:40px;row-gap:20px;align-items:center}
.orbit-core{grid-column:2;grid-row:1 / span 2;justify-self:center;align-self:center;
  width:246px;height:246px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 36%, rgba(31,123,163,.85), rgba(10,59,84,.95));
  border:1px solid rgba(160,200,225,.4);color:#f4fafd;
  display:grid;place-content:center;text-align:center;padding:0 28px;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 12px rgba(19,94,128,.14), 0 0 60px -6px rgba(31,123,163,.6)}
.orbit-core b{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:400;font-size:29px;line-height:1.14;display:block}
.orbit-item{padding:16px 20px}
.orbit-item .node-k{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:#f4fafd;display:block;margin-bottom:5px;
  transition:color .35s var(--ease)}
.orbit-item p{font-size:18px;line-height:1.45;margin:0}
.o-tl{grid-column:1;grid-row:1;text-align:right}
.o-tr{grid-column:3;grid-row:1}
.o-bl{grid-column:1;grid-row:2;text-align:right}
.o-br{grid-column:3;grid-row:2}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- slide 3 */
.versus{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 62px 1fr;align-items:center;margin-bottom:26px}
.versus .arrow{display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--orange)}
.was{background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border:1px dashed rgba(160,200,225,.26);
  border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:24px 26px}
.was h4{color:var(--ink-mute)}
.was p{color:#8CA8BA;margin:0}
.is{background:linear-gradient(140deg, rgba(241,124,33,.2), rgba(10,59,84,.6));
  border:1px solid rgba(241,124,33,.42);border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:24px 26px;
  box-shadow:0 22px 50px -26px rgba(241,124,33,.5)}
.is p{margin:0}

.gains{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:16px}
.gain{padding:22px 20px}
.gain .ic{color:var(--orange);margin-bottom:12px;display:block}
.gain h4{font-size:18px;margin-bottom:6px}
.gain p{font-size:17px;line-height:1.45;margin:0}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- theorists */
.theorist{display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100%}
.theorist .name{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:400;font-size:30px;color:#f4fafd;
  line-height:1.1;margin-bottom:4px}
.theorist .concept{font-size:15px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--orange);margin-bottom:15px}
.theorist p{font-size:18px;line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:16px}
.theorist .fact{margin-top:auto}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------- table */
.matrix{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:18px}
.matrix thead th{background:rgba(19,94,128,.45);color:#f4fafd;text-align:left;font-weight:800;
  font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:15px 20px;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-strong)}
.matrix thead th:first-child{border-top-left-radius:var(--r-sm)}
.matrix thead th:last-child{border-top-right-radius:var(--r-sm)}
.matrix tbody td{padding:14px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);vertical-align:top;
  line-height:1.42;color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:700}
.matrix tbody tr:nth-child(even){background:rgba(255,255,255,.028)}
.matrix tbody td:first-child{font-weight:800;color:#f4fafd;white-space:nowrap}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------- club system */
.hub{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 292px 1fr;
  column-gap:36px;align-items:center;height:360px}
.hub-web{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none}
.hub-col{position:relative;z-index:2;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  justify-content:space-between;height:100%;gap:8px}
.hub-col .kicker{font-size:14px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--orange);margin:0}
.hub-col.right{text-align:right}
.hub-col.right .kicker{color:#8FC4E4}
.hub-node{padding:11px 18px;display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:12px}
.hub-col.right .hub-node{justify-content:flex-end}
.hub-node.on{border-color:rgba(241,124,33,.3)}
.hub-node .node-k{font-size:17.5px;font-weight:800;color:#f4fafd;line-height:1.2;
  transition:color .35s var(--ease)}
.hub-node i{font-style:normal;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink-mute)}
.hub-core{grid-column:2;position:relative;z-index:3;justify-self:center;
  width:250px;height:250px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 36%, rgba(31,123,163,.85), rgba(10,59,84,.95));
  border:1px solid rgba(160,200,225,.4);color:#f4fafd;
  display:grid;place-content:center;text-align:center;padding:0 26px;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 12px rgba(19,94,128,.14), 0 0 60px -6px rgba(31,123,163,.6)}
.hub-core b{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:400;font-size:28px;line-height:1.12;
  display:block;margin-bottom:9px}
.hub-core span{font-size:16px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.38;color:#A7C6DA;display:block}

.club{display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100%;padding:22px 24px}
.club .node-k{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:#f4fafd;display:block;margin-bottom:3px;
  transition:color .35s var(--ease)}
.club .ar{margin-bottom:11px}
.club p{font-size:18px;line-height:1.45;margin-bottom:14px}
.club .meta{margin-top:auto;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.club .meta .chip{font-size:14px;padding:4px 12px}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ skills map */
.skills{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:17.5px;table-layout:fixed}
.skills th{font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:800;
  color:#cbdae3;padding:12px 14px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--line-strong);text-align:left}
.skills th:not(:first-child){text-align:center}
.skills td{padding:12px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:700}
.skills td:first-child{font-weight:800;color:#f4fafd}
.skills td:not(:first-child){text-align:center}
.skills tbody tr:nth-child(even){background:rgba(255,255,255,.028)}
.dot-m{display:inline-block;width:15px;height:15px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--orange);
  box-shadow:0 0 12px 1px rgba(241,124,33,.55)}
.dot-m.sec{background:transparent;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2.5px rgba(160,200,225,.45)}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------- cycle */
.cycle{position:relative;height:378px}
.cycle-ring{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1}
.cycle-step{position:absolute;width:330px;z-index:2;padding:20px 24px}
.cycle-step .n{display:inline-grid;place-content:center;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;
  background:rgba(241,124,33,.18);border:1px solid rgba(241,124,33,.5);color:var(--gold);
  font-weight:800;font-size:17px;margin-bottom:10px;transition:box-shadow .35s var(--ease)}
.cycle-step.is-lit .n{box-shadow:0 0 18px 1px rgba(241,124,33,.6)}
.cycle-step .node-k{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:#f4fafd;display:block;margin-bottom:5px;
  transition:color .35s var(--ease)}
.cycle-step p{font-size:18px;line-height:1.45;margin:0}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- closing */
.closing{padding:0;display:none}
.closing.is-active{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 540px;align-items:center}
.closing-copy{padding:0 0 0 76px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}
.closing-copy h2{font-size:58px;margin-bottom:20px}
.closing-copy p{font-size:19px;max-width:58ch}
.closing-art{position:relative;height:100%}
.closing-art .mongiz{left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);height:800px}
.closing-art::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:-140px;translate:-50% 0;
  width:560px;height:320px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(241,124,33,.3), transparent 72%);filter:blur(6px)}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- chrome */
#chrome{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:40;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;
  padding:12px 20px;background:rgba(2,8,17,.92);border-top:1px solid var(--line);
  color:var(--ink);backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
#chrome .title{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:#A7C6DA;white-space:nowrap;
  overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;flex:1}
#chrome .count{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-size:15px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap}
.btn{appearance:none;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);background:rgba(160,200,225,.08);
  color:var(--ink);border-radius:999px;padding:9px 18px;font:inherit;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;
  cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;
  transition:background .2s var(--ease),transform .2s var(--ease),
             border-color .2s var(--ease),box-shadow .2s var(--ease)}
.btn:hover{background:rgba(241,124,33,.16);border-color:rgba(241,124,33,.5);
  box-shadow:0 0 22px -6px rgba(241,124,33,.6)}
.btn:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
.btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--orange);outline-offset:3px}
.btn[disabled]{opacity:.35;cursor:not-allowed;box-shadow:none;background:rgba(160,200,225,.06);
  border-color:var(--line)}
.btn--gold{background:linear-gradient(118deg,#f7cd86 0%,#f0a94b 46%,#e8963a 100%);
  color:#2a1704;border-color:transparent;box-shadow:0 14px 34px -16px rgba(240,169,75,.85)}
.btn--gold:hover{background:linear-gradient(118deg,#f9d492 0%,#f3b25a 46%,#eda047 100%);
  box-shadow:0 20px 44px -18px rgba(240,169,75,.95)}
#bar{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;height:3px;z-index:41;width:0;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#f17c21,#f0a94b);
  box-shadow:0 0 16px 1px rgba(241,124,33,.6);transition:width .5s var(--ease)}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------- overview */
#overview{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:60;background:rgba(2,8,17,.97);
  padding:34px 40px 90px;overflow:auto;display:none}
#overview.is-open{display:block}
#overview h2{font-size:34px;margin-bottom:22px}
.thumbs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:16px}
.thumb{appearance:none;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink);font:inherit;
  background:rgba(160,200,225,.06);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-md);
  padding:16px 18px;transition:background .2s var(--ease),border-color .2s var(--ease),
  box-shadow .2s var(--ease)}
.thumb:hover{background:rgba(241,124,33,.12);border-color:rgba(241,124,33,.45);
  box-shadow:0 0 26px -8px rgba(241,124,33,.6)}
.thumb:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--orange);outline-offset:3px}
.thumb .n{font-size:14px;font-weight:800;color:var(--orange);letter-spacing:.14em;
  display:block;margin-bottom:8px}
.thumb .t{font-size:17px;line-height:1.3;font-weight:700}
.thumb[aria-current="true"]{background:linear-gradient(140deg,rgba(241,124,33,.28),rgba(10,59,84,.6));
  border-color:rgba(241,124,33,.7);box-shadow:var(--glow)}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- reveal fx */
/* The Hub's own arrival: blurred, tracked out, settling into place. */
@keyframes titleArrive{
  0%{opacity:0;filter:blur(12px);transform:translateY(22px);letter-spacing:.3em}
  to{opacity:1;filter:blur(0);transform:none}
}
@keyframes rise{to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.slide.is-active h1,
.slide.is-active h2{animation:titleArrive 1.5s var(--ease) .05s both}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px)}
.slide.is-active .reveal{animation:rise .7s var(--ease) forwards}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .reveal{opacity:1;transform:none}
  .slide.is-active .reveal{animation:none !important}
  .slide.is-active h1,.slide.is-active h2{animation:none !important}
  #bar,.btn,.node,.detail{transition:none}
}
@media print{
  body{overflow:visible;background:#020811}
  #chrome,#overview,#bar{display:none !important}
  #viewport{position:static;display:block}
  #stage{transform:none !important;box-shadow:none}
  .slide{display:block !important;page-break-after:always}
  .reveal{opacity:1;transform:none;animation:none !important}
  .slide.is-active h1,.slide.is-active h2{animation:none !important}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="bar" aria-hidden="true"></div>

<div id="viewport">
  <main id="stage" aria-live="polite">
  <canvas id="sky" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>

  <!-- ============================================================ 1 -->
  <section class="slide title-slide" data-title="The Monglish Immersive Learning Model">
    <div class="title-copy">
      <img class="brandmark reveal" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Monglish International Academy">
      <p class="eyebrow reveal" style="animation-delay:.05s">One model. Every classroom.</p>
      <h1>The Monglish <em>Immersive</em> Learning Model</h1>
      <p class="sub reveal" style="animation-delay:.12s">From theory to practice. Then into the clubs.</p>
      <p class="lede reveal" style="animation-delay:.18s">A teacher training course in fifteen slides: what immersion is, the thinking behind it, and the club ecosystem that carries it through the week.</p>
      <div class="byline reveal" style="animation-delay:.24s"><i></i> Hosted by Mongiz, your instructional guide</div>
    </div>
    <div class="title-art">
      <div class="mongiz"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Mongiz, the Monglish instructional guide, greeting with open arms"></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ============================================================ 2 -->
  <section class="slide" data-title="What immersive learning is" data-detail="Click any condition to see what it asks of you in the room.">
    <div class="head">
      <p class="eyebrow reveal">The idea</p>
      <h2>Language is not a set of rules to <em>memorise</em></h2>
      <p class="lede reveal" style="animation-delay:.1s">It is a living medium we use to understand the world. Four conditions turn a lesson into an immersion.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="orbit">
      <div class="orbit-line" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 1448 376" fill="none"><ellipse cx="724" cy="188" rx="470" ry="150" fill="none" stroke="rgba(160,200,225,.13)" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-dasharray="7 11"/><circle cx="724" cy="188" r="150" fill="none" stroke="rgba(160,200,225,.13)" stroke-width="1.2"/><path d="M609 132 L348 126" stroke="#f17c21" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="5 8" opacity=".55"/><circle cx="348" cy="126" r="4.5" fill="#f17c21" opacity=".85"/><path d="M839 132 L1100 126" stroke="#f17c21" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="5 8" opacity=".55"/><circle cx="1100" cy="126" r="4.5" fill="#f17c21" opacity=".85"/><path d="M609 244 L348 250" stroke="#f17c21" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="5 8" opacity=".55"/><circle cx="348" cy="250" r="4.5" fill="#f17c21" opacity=".85"/><path d="M839 244 L1100 250" stroke="#f17c21" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="5 8" opacity=".55"/><circle cx="1100" cy="250" r="4.5" fill="#f17c21" opacity=".85"/></svg></div>
      <div class="orbit-grid">
        <button type="button" class="node orbit-item o-tl reveal" style="animation-delay:.08s"
          data-more="<b>Context driven.</b> Open with the scene, not the rule. The learner should meet the language inside something they can picture before anyone names it.">
          <span class="node-k">Context driven</span>
          <p>Learners meet language inside authentic scenarios, not in isolated exercises.</p>
        </button>
        <div class="orbit-core reveal" style="animation-delay:.3s"><b>Meaningful communication</b></div>
        <button type="button" class="node orbit-item o-tr reveal" style="animation-delay:.14s"
          data-more="<b>Highly interactive.</b> Count the turns. If you spoke for most of the session, the learners did not get the practice the session was for.">
          <span class="node-k">Highly interactive</span>
          <p>Continuous dialogue with peers and with the teacher, in every session.</p>
        </button>
        <button type="button" class="node orbit-item o-bl reveal" style="animation-delay:.2s"
          data-more="<b>Task oriented.</b> Every stretch of language should end in something done: a map drawn, a poster written, a decision reached.">
          <span class="node-k">Task oriented</span>
          <p>English is applied to accomplish a real mission, not to complete a worksheet.</p>
        </button>
        <button type="button" class="node orbit-item o-br reveal" style="animation-delay:.26s"
          data-more="<b>Reflective.</b> Close the loop out loud. Ask what worked, what was hard, and what they would say differently next time.">
          <span class="node-k">Reflective</span>
          <p>Meaning is built through collaboration, then examined and consolidated.</p>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="detail is-idle" data-detail-for="orbit"><span class="dot"></span><p class="txt"></p></div>
  </section>

  <!-- ============================================================ 3 -->
  <section class="slide" data-title="Why we build ecosystems, not lessons">
    <div class="head">
      <p class="eyebrow reveal">The shift</p>
      <h2>Why we build ecosystems, not <em>lessons</em></h2>
    </div>

    <div class="versus reveal" style="animation-delay:.06s">
      <div class="was">
        <h4>The old way</h4>
        <p>Language studied as isolated grammar rules and disconnected exercises.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="arrow" aria-hidden="true">
        <svg width="40" height="24" viewBox="0 0 40 24" fill="none"><path d="M2 12h33m0 0-9-9m9 9-9 9" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>
      </div>
      <div class="is">
        <h4>The Monglish way</h4>
        <p>Language experienced as a living medium of communication, through context, real tasks and interactive dialogue.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="gains">
      <div class="card gain reveal" style="animation-delay:.12s">
        <span class="ic"><svg width="30" height="30" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 3a6 6 0 0 0-3.6 10.8c.6.5.9 1.1.9 1.8v.4h5.4v-.4c0-.7.3-1.3.9-1.8A6 6 0 0 0 12 3Z"/><path d="M9.8 19.5h4.4M10.3 21.5h3.4"/></svg></span>
        <h4>Deeper understanding</h4>
        <p>Meaning is internalised, not recited.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="card gain reveal" style="animation-delay:.16s">
        <span class="ic"><svg width="30" height="30" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M9 11a3 3 0 1 0 0-6 3 3 0 0 0 0 6Z"/><path d="M3 20c0-3 2.7-5 6-5s6 2 6 5"/><path d="M16.5 6.5a3 3 0 0 1 0 5"/><path d="M18 15.6c2 .7 3 2.2 3 4.4"/></svg></span>
        <h4>Stronger engagement</h4>
        <p>An active part in a working community.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="card gain reveal" style="animation-delay:.2s">
        <span class="ic"><svg width="30" height="30" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M13 2 4.5 13.5H11L10 22l8.5-11.5H12L13 2Z"/></svg></span>
        <h4>Intrinsic motivation</h4>
        <p>Curiosity and real use drive the work.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="card gain reveal" style="animation-delay:.24s">
        <span class="ic"><svg width="30" height="30" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 7a8 3.4 0 1 0 16 0A8 3.4 0 1 0 4 7Z"/><path d="M4 7v10c0 1.9 3.6 3.4 8 3.4s8-1.5 8-3.4V7"/><path d="M4 12c0 1.9 3.6 3.4 8 3.4s8-1.5 8-3.4"/></svg></span>
        <h4>Better retention</h4>
        <p>Language anchored to lived context.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="card gain reveal" style="animation-delay:.28s">
        <span class="ic"><svg width="30" height="30" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M20 12a7 7 0 0 1-7 7H8l-4 3V12a7 7 0 0 1 7-7h2a7 7 0 0 1 7 7Z"/><path d="M9 11h6M9 14.5h3.5"/></svg></span>
        <h4>Communication confidence</h4>
        <p>Oracy grows in low stakes exchange.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="note reveal" style="left:76px;bottom:120px;animation-delay:.34s;max-width:620px">
      <img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="">
      <div>
        <p class="who">Mongiz note</p>
        <p>The ecosystem is the unit of planning. A single excellent lesson that connects to nothing still leaves the learner where it found them.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ============================================================ 4 -->
  <section class="slide" data-title="Constructing knowledge: Vygotsky, Piaget, Bruner">
    <div class="head">
      <p class="eyebrow reveal">Theoretical foundations, part one</p>
      <h2>Constructing <em>knowledge</em></h2>
      <p class="lede reveal" style="animation-delay:.1s">Three ideas that decide how a Monglish room is arranged before a single word is taught.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="grid g3" style="align-items:stretch;min-height:372px">
      <article class="card theorist reveal" style="animation-delay:.08s">
        <span class="name">Lev Vygotsky</span>
        <span class="concept">Social constructivism, ZPD</span>
        <p>Learning happens in the gap between what a learner can do alone and what they can do with guidance. The gap is where teaching belongs.</p>
        <div class="fact"><b>In our rooms:</b> pair work, group interaction and collaborative problem solving, in class and in the clubs.</div>
      </article>
      <article class="card theorist reveal" style="animation-delay:.14s">
        <span class="name">Jean Piaget</span>
        <span class="concept">Cognitive constructivism</span>
        <p>Learners build mental frameworks through exploration. Knowledge is assembled by the learner, not handed over by the teacher.</p>
        <div class="fact"><b>In our rooms:</b> spatial patterns such as <em class="accent">on</em> and <em class="accent">under</em> are discovered through repeated context, not memorised from a chart.</div>
      </article>
      <article class="card theorist reveal" style="animation-delay:.2s">
        <span class="name">Jerome Bruner</span>
        <span class="concept">Scaffolding, discovery learning</span>
        <p>The teacher provides temporary support at the point of difficulty, then withdraws it deliberately so the learner carries the weight.</p>
        <div class="fact"><b>In our rooms:</b> digital pointers and visual prompts fade as the learner takes over the turn.</div>
      </article>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ============================================================ 5 -->
  <section class="slide" data-title="Language in action: Krashen, Swain, Halliday, Dewey">
    <div class="head">
      <p class="eyebrow reveal">Theoretical foundations, part two</p>
      <h2>Language in <em>action</em></h2>
      <p class="lede reveal" style="animation-delay:.1s">Four ideas that decide what actually happens in the minutes of a session.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="grid g4" style="align-items:stretch;min-height:372px">
      <article class="card theorist reveal" style="animation-delay:.08s">
        <span class="name">Stephen Krashen</span>
        <span class="concept">Comprehensible input</span>
        <p>Language a step above the current level, made understandable by visuals, stories and context.</p>
        <div class="fact"><b>In our rooms:</b> teacher storytelling carried by rich visual scenes.</div>
      </article>
      <article class="card theorist reveal" style="animation-delay:.13s">
        <span class="name">Merrill Swain</span>
        <span class="concept">Output hypothesis</span>
        <p>Learners must produce language, speak it or write it, to notice their own gaps and build fluency.</p>
        <div class="fact"><b>In our rooms:</b> guided microphone turns first, then independent speaking.</div>
      </article>
      <article class="card theorist reveal" style="animation-delay:.18s">
        <span class="name">Michael Halliday</span>
        <span class="concept">Language as social meaning</span>
        <p>Language exists to express ideas and build relationships, not only to be grammatically correct.</p>
        <div class="fact"><b>In our rooms:</b> real ideas and shared values, such as kindness and friendship, carried in English.</div>
      </article>
      <article class="card theorist reveal" style="animation-delay:.23s">
        <span class="name">John Dewey</span>
        <span class="concept">Experiential learning</span>
        <p>Education requires applying knowledge to real, practical situations and solving genuine problems.</p>
        <div class="fact"><b>In our rooms:</b> missions and club tasks that use the language the same day it is met.</div>
      </article>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ============================================================ 6 -->
  <section class="slide" data-title="From theory to the online classroom">
    <div class="head">
      <p class="eyebrow reveal">Translation</p>
      <h2>From theory to the online <em>classroom</em></h2>
      <p class="lede reveal" style="animation-delay:.1s">Every principle has one observable behaviour a supervisor can look for.</p>
    </div>
    <table class="matrix reveal" style="animation-delay:.16s">
      <thead>
        <tr><th style="width:170px">Theorist</th><th style="width:300px">Principle</th><th>What you would see in the session</th></tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr><td>Vygotsky</td><td>ZPD and collaboration</td><td>Breakout room peer discussion before any individual answer is asked for.</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Piaget</td><td>Discovery learning</td><td>A visual context is presented first; the grammar rule is named afterwards, if at all.</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Bruner</td><td>Scaffolding</td><td>Digital pointers and prompts are withdrawn across the session, not repeated.</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Krashen</td><td>Comprehensible input</td><td>Teacher storytelling anchored to a rich visual scene, at one step above the level.</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Swain</td><td>Output hypothesis</td><td>Guided microphone turns, then unscripted speaking by every learner.</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Halliday</td><td>Social meaning</td><td>Learners negotiate a shared decision, not a right answer.</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Dewey</td><td>Experiential learning</td><td>A mission is set that uses the session's language in a real task.</td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </section>

  <!-- ============================================================ 7 -->
  <section class="slide" data-title="Anatomy of a main session">
    <div class="head">
      <p class="eyebrow reveal">The core lesson</p>
      <h2>Anatomy of a main <em>session</em></h2>
      <p class="lede reveal" style="animation-delay:.1s">The main session does not isolate skills. Vocabulary, grammar and pronunciation are carried by one meaningful context.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="grid g2" style="max-width:980px;gap:20px">
      <article class="card reveal" style="animation-delay:.08s">
        <h3>Comprehensible input</h3>
        <p style="margin:0">Visual slides and digital pointers supply the context before any explanation is offered.</p>
      </article>
      <article class="card reveal" style="animation-delay:.13s">
        <h3>Vocabulary and grammar together</h3>
        <p style="margin:0">Systems are learned at the same time. <em class="accent">Under</em> is grasped visually, not through a grammar chart.</p>
      </article>
      <article class="card reveal" style="animation-delay:.18s">
        <h3>Oracy development</h3>
        <p style="margin:0">Immediate practice of pronunciation and question formation, in the same minutes the language appears.</p>
      </article>
      <article class="card reveal" style="animation-delay:.23s">
        <h3>Scaffolded interaction</h3>
        <p style="margin:0">The teacher guides microphone turns and peer exchanges, then steps back for independent use.</p>
      </article>
    </div>
    <div class="note reveal" style="right:76px;top:302px;animation-delay:.3s;max-width:410px">
      <img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="">
      <div>
        <p class="who">Mongiz note</p>
        <p>Twice a week, on campus, in a class of eight to ten learners. Small enough that every learner speaks.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="mongiz reveal" style="right:116px;bottom:104px;height:242px;animation-delay:.34s">
      <img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="">
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ============================================================ 8 -->
  <section class="slide" data-title="Theory in action: Power Up Unit 1">
    <div class="head">
      <p class="eyebrow reveal">Worked example</p>
      <h2>Theory in action: Power Up <em>Unit 1</em></h2>
      <p class="lede reveal" style="animation-delay:.1s">Context: classroom objects and location questions.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="grid" style="grid-template-columns:1.25fr 1fr;gap:34px;align-items:start">
      <div class="grid" style="gap:16px">
        <div class="card card--tint reveal" style="animation-delay:.08s">
          <h4>1. The scene arrives first</h4>
          <p style="margin:0">A messy classroom on screen, and one question: <strong>where is the pencil?</strong></p>
        </div>
        <div class="card card--tint reveal" style="animation-delay:.13s">
          <h4>2. The pattern is noticed</h4>
          <p style="margin:0">Answers come back as language, not as labels: <strong>it is under the desk</strong>, <strong>it is on the chair</strong>.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="card card--tint reveal" style="animation-delay:.18s">
          <h4>3. The rule is named last</h4>
          <p style="margin:0">Only once learners are using the pattern does anyone call it a preposition.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <aside class="card card--accent reveal" style="animation-delay:.24s">
        <h3>Why this order matters</h3>
        <p>We do not open with a rule about prepositions. We open with a messy room and a question.</p>
        <p style="margin-bottom:0"><strong style="color:var(--gold)">Grammar is discovered, not dictated.</strong></p>
      </aside>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ============================================================ 9 -->
  <section class="slide" data-title="Missions: the bridge to application" data-detail="Click a stage of the bridge to see what it asks of you.">
    <div class="head">
      <p class="eyebrow reveal">Between the lesson and the clubs</p>
      <h2>Missions: the bridge to <em>application</em></h2>
      <p class="lede reveal" style="animation-delay:.1s">A mission is the primer. It gives learners the vocabulary and the context the clubs will then explore in depth.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="grid g3 reveal" style="animation-delay:.08s;margin-bottom:26px">
      <div class="card"><h4>Label the classroom</h4><p style="margin:0">Objects named and placed by the learners themselves.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>Draw a classroom map</h4><p style="margin:0">Location language used to describe a real space.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>Welcome a new student</h4><p style="margin:0">Materials organised and a poster written for someone real.</p></div>
    </div>

    <div class="versus reveal" style="animation-delay:.16s;grid-template-columns:1fr 62px 1fr 62px 1fr;margin-bottom:0">
      <button type="button" class="node" style="text-align:center;padding:20px"
        data-more="<b>Main session.</b> Your job is input and scaffolding: build the context, model the language, hand out the turns."><span class="node-k" style="display:block;font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:#f4fafd">Main session</span><p class="small" style="margin:5px 0 0">Input and scaffolding</p></button>
      <div class="arrow" aria-hidden="true"><svg width="40" height="24" viewBox="0 0 40 24" fill="none"><path d="M2 12h33m0 0-9-9m9 9-9 9" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></div>
      <button type="button" class="node" style="text-align:center;padding:20px;border-color:rgba(241,124,33,.4)"
        data-more="<b>Mission.</b> Set it in the session that taught the language, never a week later. The point of a mission is that the words are still warm."><span class="node-k" style="display:block;font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:#f4fafd">Mission</span><p class="small" style="margin:5px 0 0">Language applied the same day</p></button>
      <div class="arrow" aria-hidden="true"><svg width="40" height="24" viewBox="0 0 40 24" fill="none"><path d="M2 12h33m0 0-9-9m9 9-9 9" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></div>
      <button type="button" class="node" style="text-align:center;padding:20px"
        data-more="<b>Clubs.</b> The same language, now at length and in company: read, performed, argued, sung, drawn."><span class="node-k" style="display:block;font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:#f4fafd">Clubs</span><p class="small" style="margin:5px 0 0">Deep, extended exploration</p></button>
    </div>
    <div class="detail is-idle" data-detail-for="bridge"><span class="dot"></span><p class="txt"></p></div>
  </section>

  <!-- ============================================================ 10 -->
  <section class="slide" data-title="The Monglish club ecosystem" data-detail="Click any club to see its full entry from the academy's own list.">
    <div class="head" style="margin-bottom:22px">
      <p class="eyebrow reveal">The ecosystem</p>
      <h2>Nine clubs around one main <em>session</em></h2>
      <p class="lede reveal" style="animation-delay:.1s">Four run on campus and carry the immersion. Five run online and extend it through the week.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="hub">
      <div class="hub-web" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 1448 360" fill="none"><defs><marker id="hbL" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8.5" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto"><path d="M0 1 L9 5 L0 9 z" fill="#f17c21"/></marker><marker id="hbR" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8.5" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto"><path d="M0 1 L9 5 L0 9 z" fill="#5E9FC6"/></marker></defs><circle cx="724" cy="180" r="155" fill="none" stroke="rgba(160,200,225,.13)" stroke-width="1.2"/><path d="M556 50 L556 310" stroke="#f17c21" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" opacity=".55"/><path d="M591 180 L564 180" stroke="#f17c21" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 8" opacity=".7" marker-end="url(#hbL)"/><path d="M892 29 L892 331" stroke="#5E9FC6" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" opacity=".55"/><path d="M857 180 L884 180" stroke="#5E9FC6" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 8" opacity=".7" marker-end="url(#hbR)"/></svg></div>
      <div class="hub-col left">
        <p class="kicker reveal" style="animation-delay:.06s">On campus, immersion</p>
        <button type="button" class="node hub-node on reveal" style="animation-delay:0.10s" data-more="<b>Reading &amp; Speaking Caf&eacute;.</b> Literacy and oral practice in the same sitting, on campus in the Immersion and Immersion Plus models. All stages."><span class="node-k">Reading &amp; Speaking Caf&eacute;</span><i>All stages</i></button>

<nav id="chrome" aria-label="Presentation controls">
  <button class="btn" id="prev" type="button">Previous</button>
  <button class="btn btn--gold" id="next" type="button">Next</button>
  <span class="title" id="slideTitle"></span>
  <button class="btn" id="grid" type="button" aria-expanded="false">All slides</button>
  <span class="count" id="count"></span>
</nav>

<div id="overview" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="All slides">
  <h2>All slides</h2>
  <div class="thumbs" id="thumbs"></div>
</div>

<script>
(function(){
  "use strict";
  var stage = document.getElementById('stage');
  var slides = Array.prototype.slice.call(stage.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
  var bar = document.getElementById('bar');
  var countEl = document.getElementById('count');
  var titleEl = document.getElementById('slideTitle');
  var prevBtn = document.getElementById('prev');
  var nextBtn = document.getElementById('next');
  var gridBtn = document.getElementById('grid');
  var overview = document.getElementById('overview');
  var thumbs = document.getElementById('thumbs');
  var reduced = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  var i = 0;

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------- starfield */
  /* The Hub's own background, ported: three parallax layers of drifting
     stars over three slow orbit rings. 2D canvas, because this is a few
     hundred dots and three ellipses, not a scene. */
  (function sky(){
    var canvas = document.getElementById('sky');
    var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if(!ctx) return;
    var W = 1600, H = 900;
    var LAYERS = [
      {n:120, speed:.0022, size:[.4,.9],  alpha:[.18,.4]},
      {n:70,  speed:.0045, size:[.7,1.5], alpha:[.3,.6]},
      {n:26,  speed:.008,  size:[1.1,2.3],alpha:[.45,.85]}
    ];
    var RINGS = [
      {r:.46, tilt:.34,  speed:.011, color:'rgba(120,186,224,.10)'},
      {r:.62, tilt:-.22, speed:-.008,color:'rgba(240,169,75,.07)'},
      {r:.8,  tilt:.5,   speed:.005, color:'rgba(120,186,224,.06)'}
    ];
    function rng(seed){var s=seed>>>0;return function(){return (s=(s*1664525+1013904223)>>>0)/4294967296;};}
    var stars = [];
    var rand = rng(20260920);            // fixed seed: the same sky every time
    LAYERS.forEach(function(L){
      for(var k=0;k<L.n;k++) stars.push({
        x:rand(), y:rand(),
        r:L.size[0]+rand()*(L.size[1]-L.size[0]),
        a:L.alpha[0]+rand()*(L.alpha[1]-L.alpha[0]),
        speed:L.speed, phase:rand()*Math.PI*2, rate:.25+rand()*.6
      });
    });
    var dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
    canvas.width = W*dpr; canvas.height = H*dpr;
    canvas.style.width = W+'px'; canvas.style.height = H+'px';
    ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);

    function draw(t){
      ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
      var cx = W/2, cy = H*.42, base = Math.min(W,H);
      RINGS.forEach(function(ring){
        ctx.save(); ctx.translate(cx,cy); ctx.rotate(ring.tilt + t*ring.speed);
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,0, base*ring.r, base*ring.r*.34, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
        ctx.strokeStyle = ring.color; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.stroke(); ctx.restore();
      });
      for(var k=0;k<stars.length;k++){
        var s = stars[k];
        var y = reduced.matches ? s.y : (s.y - t*s.speed) % 1;
        var yy = (y<0 ? y+1 : y) * H;
        var tw = reduced.matches ? 1 : .65 + .35*Math.sin(t*s.rate + s.phase);
        ctx.globalAlpha = s.a * tw;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x*W, yy, s.r, 0, Math.PI*2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#cfe6f5'; ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }
    var raf = 0, t0 = performance.now() - 1000;
    function loop(now){ draw((now-t0)/1000); raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
    function play(){ if(raf || reduced.matches) return; raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
    function pause(){ cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = 0; }
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function(){ document.hidden ? pause() : play(); });
    draw(1); play();
  })();

  /* -------------------------------------------------- interactive nodes */
  /* One node lit at a time per diagram. Clicking the lit node turns it off. */
  slides.forEach(function(slide){
    var detail = slide.querySelector('.detail');
    var nodes = Array.prototype.slice.call(slide.querySelectorAll('.node[data-more]'));
    if(!nodes.length) return;
    var idle = slide.dataset.detail || 'Select any item above to read more.';
    if(detail) detail.querySelector('.txt').innerHTML = idle;

    nodes.forEach(function(node){
      node.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');
      node.addEventListener('click', function(){
        var on = node.classList.contains('is-lit');
        nodes.forEach(function(n){ n.classList.remove('is-lit'); n.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false'); });
        if(on){
          if(detail){ detail.classList.remove('is-lit'); detail.classList.add('is-idle');
                      detail.querySelector('.txt').innerHTML = idle; }
          return;
        }
        node.classList.add('is-lit');
        node.setAttribute('aria-pressed','true');
        if(detail){ detail.classList.add('is-lit'); detail.classList.remove('is-idle');
                    detail.querySelector('.txt').innerHTML = node.dataset.more; }
      });
    });
    slide.resetNodes = function(){
      nodes.forEach(function(n){ n.classList.remove('is-lit'); n.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false'); });
      if(detail){ detail.classList.remove('is-lit'); detail.classList.add('is-idle');
                  detail.querySelector('.txt').innerHTML = idle; }
    };
  });

  /* A running footer on every content slide. */
  slides.forEach(function(s, k){
    if(s.classList.contains('title-slide') || s.classList.contains('closing')) return;
    var f = document.createElement('div');
    f.className = 'slide-foot';
    f.innerHTML = '<span>Monglish International Academy, teacher training</span>' +
                  '<span class="pg">' + String(k+1).padStart(2,'0') + ' / ' + String(slides.length).padStart(2,'0') + '</span>';
    s.appendChild(f);
  });

  /* Scale the fixed 1600x900 stage into whatever window it lands in. */
  function fit(){
    var pad = 22, chrome = 60;
    var s = Math.min((window.innerWidth - pad*2)/1600, (window.innerHeight - chrome - pad*2)/900);
    stage.style.transform = 'scale(' + s + ')';
  }

  function show(n, writeHash){
    i = (n + slides.length) % slides.length;
    slides.forEach(function(s, k){
      var on = k === i;
      s.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
      if(on){
        if(s.resetNodes) s.resetNodes();
        s.querySelectorAll('.reveal, h1, h2').forEach(function(el){
          el.style.animation = 'none'; void el.offsetHeight; el.style.animation = '';
        });
      }
    });
    bar.style.width = ((i+1)/slides.length*100) + '%';
    countEl.textContent = (i+1) + ' / ' + slides.length;
    titleEl.textContent = slides[i].dataset.title;
    prevBtn.disabled = i === 0;
    nextBtn.disabled = i === slides.length - 1;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(thumbs.children, function(t, k){
      t.setAttribute('aria-current', k === i ? 'true' : 'false');
    });
    if(writeHash !== false) history.replaceState(null, '', '#s' + (i+1));
  }

  slides.forEach(function(s, k){
    var b = document.createElement('button');
    b.className = 'thumb'; b.type = 'button';
    b.innerHTML = '<span class="n">' + String(k+1).padStart(2,'0') + '</span><span class="t"></span>';
    b.querySelector('.t').textContent = s.dataset.title;
    b.addEventListener('click', function(){ closeOverview(); show(k); });
    thumbs.appendChild(b);
  });

  function openOverview(){ overview.classList.add('is-open'); gridBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true'); thumbs.children[i].focus(); }
  function closeOverview(){ overview.classList.remove('is-open'); gridBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false'); }
  function toggleOverview(){ overview.classList.contains('is-open') ? closeOverview() : openOverview(); }

  prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){ show(i-1); });
  nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){ show(i+1); });
  gridBtn.addEventListener('click', toggleOverview);

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
    if(e.key === 'Escape'){ if(overview.classList.contains('is-open')){ closeOverview(); e.preventDefault(); } return; }
    if(overview.classList.contains('is-open')) return;
    /* Space and Enter belong to whichever node has focus. */
    var onNode = document.activeElement && document.activeElement.classList.contains('node');
    switch(e.key){
      case 'ArrowRight': case 'PageDown': e.preventDefault(); show(i+1); break;
      case ' ': if(onNode) return; e.preventDefault(); show(i+1); break;
      case 'ArrowLeft': case 'PageUp': e.preventDefault(); show(i-1); break;
      case 'Home': e.preventDefault(); show(0); break;
      case 'End': e.preventDefault(); show(slides.length-1); break;
      case 'g': case 'G': e.preventDefault(); toggleOverview(); break;
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener('resize', fit);
  fit();

  window.addEventListener('hashchange', function(){
    var n = parseInt((location.hash || '').replace('#s',''), 10);
    if(!isNaN(n) && n - 1 !== i) show(n - 1, false);
  });

  var start = parseInt((location.hash || '').replace('#s',''), 10);
  show(isNaN(start) ? 0 : start - 1, false);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
